findings.remediation: Prove all four swap quadrants, the executed-not-requested basis, partial-fill reverts, slippage and zero-sum settlement with specialist review. The four-quadrant proof and the solvency invariant are bound in the evidence index; the specialist review remains a maintainer-owned gate.
findings.summary: beforeSwapReturnDelta can bypass concentrated-liquidity swap math and carve value out of the specified currency. It is enabled deliberately because the mandatory quadrant-dependent quote-side basis cannot be collected without it on the two quadrants where the quote asset is the specified currency.
